GlobalValueSet.description: Tracks the lifecycle of a corporate matching-gift request against a Gift Transaction. Shared between GiftTransaction.FQS_Match_Status__c (canonical) and GiftEntry.FQS_Match_Status__c (staging mirror). Distinct from FQS_Matched__c (boolean, set when the matching-employer transaction is linked): Match Status covers the whole workflow — Eligible (identified as match-eligible), Request Confirmed (submitted to employer), Received (match arrived, MatchingEmployerTransactionId now set), Declined (employer refused), N/A (no match expected).
